item.title: Tell HN: Tally Data Breach
item.summary: Received a notice from tally.so notifying that someone accessed their user database. I have asked which “hash” they use and whether passwords are salted. I have not heard back yet. — On August 3, an attacker gained unauthorized access to Metabase, the analytics service we use to see how Tally is used. Through that they reached your email address, and your password as a cryptographic hash. A hash is one-way, so it can't be turned back into your password. They didn't reach your forms, or the answers people submitted to them. Those are stored separately. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49213500 Points: 3 # Comments: 1
